units.source_text: 大概是十月中旬的一天，我起晚了，穿着和服就急匆匆赶到学校去了。

en.t: One day around the middle of October, I got up late and hurried off to school still wearing my kimono.

units.source_text: 由于来不及系皮靴的鞋带，趿拉着草履就跑出去了。

en.t: Since I had no time to lace up my leather boots, I slipped on my straw sandals and ran out.

units.source_text: 那天，按课程表，我应该比K先回家的。

en.t: According to the timetable that day, I was supposed to get home before K.

units.source_text: 所以，一回来，我就‘哗啦’一声拉开了格子门，

en.t: So when I came back, I slid the lattice door open with a loud clatter,

units.source_text: 突然听到了以为还没回来的K的说话声，同时传来了小姐的笑声。

en.t: and suddenly heard K speaking, though I had thought he was not back yet, along with the young lady's laughter.

units.source_text: 因为那天我没穿那双费事儿的靴子，所以立刻走进去，打开了隔扇。

en.t: Because I was not wearing those troublesome boots that day, I went straight in and opened the sliding partition.

units.source_text: 我看见了一如往常坐在桌前的K，

en.t: I saw K sitting at his desk as usual,

units.source_text: 但是小姐已经不在这里了，只是她那从K的房间里逃走似的背影从眼前闪过。

en.t: but the young lady was no longer there; only her retreating figure, as if fleeing from K's room, flashed before my eyes.

units.source_text: 我问K，怎么回来得这么早。

en.t: I asked K why he had come back so early.

units.source_text: 他说心情不好，没有去上课。

en.t: He said he had felt unwell and had not gone to class.

units.source_text: 我走进自己的房间，坐了下来。

en.t: I went into my own room and sat down.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，小姐送茶进来。

en.t: Before long, the young lady came in bringing tea.

units.source_text: 直到这时，她才对我问候了一声‘回来啦’。

en.t: Only then did she greet me with a word of welcome home.

units.source_text: 我不是那种讨巧的男人，不会笑着问她，刚才干吗逃跑呀，

en.t: I was not the sort of clever, easygoing man who could laugh and ask her why she had run away just now,

units.source_text: 可心里总是惦记着这件事。

en.t: but the matter stayed on my mind all the same.

units.source_text: 小姐没坐多久，就离开我的房间，沿着走廊回自己房间去了。

en.t: The young lady did not sit long; she left my room and went back to her own along the corridor.

units.source_text: 但是，她路过K的房间时停了下来，站在门口跟K说了两三句话，

en.t: But when she passed K's room, she stopped and exchanged a few words with him at the doorway,

units.source_text: 像是接着刚才没说完的话茬。

en.t: as though continuing the conversation that had been left unfinished earlier.

units.source_text: 我没听见前面的，也不知他们在说什么。

en.t: Since I had not heard the earlier part, I had no idea what they were talking about.
